content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Little Rock

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and project-management experience. Review PMI's official eligibility criteria—typically a secondary degree plus defined years of direct project experience, or a four-year degree with fewer years required. Granite PM Academy's enrollment team can help you verify you meet the prerequisites before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course delivered by experienced, PMI-authorized trainers. You'll cover the PMBOK Guide framework, exam domains, and real-world scenarios across five full days. Flexible scheduling accommodates working professionals in Little Rock; all instruction is interactive and recorded for review.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing your 35 contact hours, submit your official PMP application directly to PMI with your course completion certificate from Granite PM Academy. Include documentation of your project-management experience and pay the PMI examination fee. Our team provides step-by-step guidance through this process.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice exams, study guides, and Q&A reviews—to reinforce your learning. Schedule your computer-based exam at a PMI-approved testing center. Our instructors remain available to clarify concepts and build your confidence before test day.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: The PMP is valid for three years. To renew, earn professional development units (PDUs) through eligible learning activities, conferences, and volunteer work. Granite PM Academy offers PDU-qualifying courses and resources to help you stay current and support your ongoing career growth in Little Rock's growing project-management sector.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.
